sentences.en: I had a bowl of noodles at a street nearby.
sentences.zh: 我在附近的一条街上吃了一碗面条。

sentences.en: You're right. The noodle broth here is a bit expensive.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。这里的面条汤有点贵。

sentences.en: Your fine, curly hair looks as appetizing as glass noodles.
sentences.zh: 你那细卷的头发看起来像玻璃凉粉一样诱人。
